name: ros-livekit-bridge
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && mkdir -p src/externals && if [ -f external.repos ]; then vcs import --recursive --skip-existing src/externals < external.repos; fi && ./src/externals/cpp-tools/install.sh --repo-root "$PWD" --force && rosdep update && apt-get update && rosdep install --from-paths src/ros2_livekit_bridge src/ros2_livekit_bridge_config src/ros2_livekit_bridge_msgs src/externals/ros2_medkit/src/ros2_medkit_cmake src/externals/ros2_medkit/src/ros2_medkit_serialization src/test/waveshare_driver --ignore-src -r -y --skip-keys ament_cmake_clang_tidy'
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'if [ -d src/externals ]; then for repo in src/externals/*; do if [ -d "$repo/.git" ]; then if [ -n "$(git -C "$repo" status --porcelain)" ]; then echo "Skipping pull for $repo because it has local changes"; elif ! git -C "$repo" symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD >/dev/null; then echo "Skipping pull for $repo because it is detached HEAD"; else git -C "$repo" pull --recurse-submodules; fi; fi; done; fi'
